title: Short Grit Scale
description: 8 statements rated 1–5 (very much like me to not like me at all).

citation.text: Duckworth AL, Quinn PD (2009). Development and validation of the Short Grit Scale (Grit-S). Journal of Personality Assessment 91(2):166–174.

scoring.text: Mean of the 8 items (1–5) after reversing the consistency-of-interest items 1, 3, 5 and 6, with 5 = very much like me. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: Enter the options so that value 5 means 'very much like me' for the perseverance items; the recipe reverses items 1, 3, 5 and 6.
